1. PARTIES
This Agreement is entered between AGVS ENTERPRISES PVT. LTD. (“Scented Slogan”) in Mumbai, and {{ doc.customer }}.

2. SERVICES
2.1 During the term of this Agreement, Scented Slogan agrees to provide to “the Customer”, at its appointed premises (“Serviced Premises”), the following services (“the Services”):-
  • Provision of Equipment (as defined in clause 3.1);
  • Provision of Fragrance for diffusion in equipment;
  • Provision of installation of Equipment with Fragrance at serviced Premises;
  • Warranty on equipment parts, excluding burnt or physical damages, till the effective agreement term (5.1);
  • Services performed in coordination with customer’s representative (“Nominated Contact”).

2.2 Nominated Contact at the Serviced Premises to be contacted for delivery and installation of Equipment and Fragrance.
Unique to store locations. Please refer Annexure-1.

2.3 Nominated Contact for Equipment, Fragrance and Accounting matters:
{{ doc.contact_person }} {{ doc.contact_phone or doc.contact_mobile }}

Description Amount (INR)
Ambient diffusion system with Scented Slogan. Premium Fragrance fixed quarterly billing per scriptor. {{ doc.total }}

Taxes {{ doc.total_taxes_and_charges }}

Note: Customer must provide electrical power point. Shelving system and any other specific requirements will be charged at their own costs. Scented Slogan will only provide Equipment and Fragrance.

5. TERM
5.1 This Agreement shall be effective for a term of 12 months commencing from 01.08.2025 and expiring on 01.07.2026.

Termination:

5.2 Either party can terminate this agreement by providing a 2 month written notice to the other party by registered mail.

6. PROVISION OF EQUIPMENT

6.1 The Customer hereby grants to Scented Slogan (subject to any necessary government or third party approvals) the right to install all necessary Equipment for receiving the Services. The Customer shall be solely responsible for obtaining any governmental or third party approvals for the installation of such Equipment and for all costs associated therewith.

6.2 Scented Slogan shall ensure that the technical team have all necessary requirements to carry out the services with due care.

7. EXCLUSIVITY OF SERVICE

The Customer agrees to use only the Services, Equipment, and Consumables provided by Scented Slogan for the duration of this Agreement. All FTU (FreeTo-Use) machines remain the sole responsibility of Scented Slogan. Refilling, maintenance, or any intervention by the Customer or third parties is strictly prohibited without prior written consent.


In certain locations where routine site visits are not feasible, Scented Slogan will ship fragrance oils monthly and provide remote support. In such cases, designated client personnel—trained by Scented Slogan either on-site or virtually—may handle basic operations like oil replacement. Any advanced service needs will be addressed by our team as required.


8. WARRANTY

During the services agreement period as stated at the Term (5.1), Scented Slogan shall warrant the Equipment supplied under this Agreement will be of merchantable quality. In the event that any part of the Equipment is found defective within the agreement period and were resulted from manufacturer’s defects, Scented Slogan will provide replacement which shall be installed by technicians of Scented Slogan

9. MAINTENANCE

Scented Slogan shall maintain the Equipment for the term of this Agreement at no additional cost. All maintenance shall be limited to wear and tear resulted from ordinary and proper use of the Equipment.

10. GENERAL
1. This Agreement constitutes the sole and entire understanding between Parties with respect to the subject matter hereof and supersedes all prior conversations, representations, promises whether verbal or written. No modification of this Agreement shall be valid unless made in writing and signed by each party.
2. The parties further agree to keep confidential any information relating to this Agreement unless the consent to disclose such information is obtained from the other party in advance.
3. This Agreement shall become binding on the parties hereto when signed & accepted by both, the Customer and Scented Slogan.
4. The Customer may, from time to time, request the installation of additional machines at the existing premises or at alternative locations. Upon receipt of such a request, the Service Provider shall use its best efforts to complete the installation of the additional machines within a period of two (2) to three (3) weeks from the date of the request. Billing for the additional machines shall commence from the date of their installation.
5. For installations at remote or distant locations, the Service Provider may, at its discretion, deliver the machines to the Customer at the premises of “{{ doc.customer }}” or such other designated location as may be mutually agreed. In such cases, the Service Provider shall provide remote assistance to the Customer for installation via video conferencing or other suitable virtual means.


THIS AGREEMENT has been signed on the 2nd day of August 2025.
